title: Team & workspaces
personalIntro: Create a shared team workspace to pool monthly video hours, AI edits, clips, and social channels.
teamIntro: Manage pooled usage, seats, billing, and team members.

signInRequired.title: Sign In Required
signInRequired.body: Sign in to manage your team workspace, seats, and invitations.

yourTeams.title: Your teams
yourTeams.description: Switch into a team workspace to view pooled usage and manage members.

create.dialogDescription: Starts at ${price}/mo for {seats} seats and {hours} pooled hours/mo. Each extra seat adds +{extraHours} hours for +${extraPrice}/mo.
create.cardDescription: Share clips, templates, social accounts, and a pooled monthly video allowance with your crew.
create.planSummary: Includes {seats} seats and {hours} hours of pooled source video/mo. Add seats anytime for +${extraPrice}/seat (+{extraHours} hours each).

overview.pooledMonthly: Shared across the team this month
overview.yourLimitPaused: Your seat is paused by an admin

seats.usedSummary: {occupied} of {limit} seats used across active members and pending invitations.
seats.stepperHint: {included} seats included. Each additional seat adds +{extraHours} pooled hours/mo (+${extraPrice}{period}).
seats.minimumNote: You currently have {occupied} occupied seats (members + pending invites). Remove members or revoke invites to lower your seat count further.
seats.capReachedBanner: All {occupied} of {limit} seats are in use. Add seats above before inviting another teammate.

billing.title: Team plan & seats
billing.activeDescription: Adjust paid seats or manage invoices and payment methods in Stripe.
billing.inactiveDescription: Choose your team size and billing cycle to activate pooled hours for everyone on this team.
billing.extraSeatsLine: {count, plural, one {# extra seat} other {# extra seats}} (${price} each, +{hours} hrs/mo)
billing.includedFeatures: Includes {resolution} clips, videos up to {youtubeHours}h each, social scheduling, and {aiEdits} pooled AI edits/mo.
billing.prorationNote: Added seats are charged right away for the rest of the billing period. Removing seats takes effect immediately and isn't refunded.
billing.ownerOnlyNotice: Only the team owner can start a subscription, change seat counts, or manage billing.
billing.paymentFailed: Your team's last payment failed. Update the payment method to keep clipping.
billing.cancelScheduled: This team subscription is scheduled to cancel on {date}.
billing.includedFeaturesNoScheduling: Includes {resolution} clips, videos up to {youtubeHours}h each, and {aiEdits} pooled AI edits/mo.

members.title: Members & invitations
members.inviteLinkSent: Invite emailed to {email}. You can also share the link directly:
members.inviteLinkShare: Invite created for {email}. Share this invite link with them:
members.leaveConfirm: Leave {team}? You will lose access to its shared clips and workspace.
members.limitsDialogDescription: Set optional monthly caps for {name} within {team}'s shared pool. Leave blank for unlimited.
members.limitsCurrentUsage: Used this billing period: {minutes} min video · {aiEdits} AI edits
members.minuteLimitPausedHint: Blocks new video generations for this seat without removing them.
members.minuteLimitUnlimitedHint: Can use any remaining minutes in the team pool.
members.aiLimitPausedHint: Disables AI editor requests for this seat.
members.subscribeToInvite: Start the Team subscription to invite teammates.

general.title: General
general.description: Update how this team appears in the workspace switcher and invite emails.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Owner-only actions for transferring or permanently deleting this team.
danger.transferConfirm: Transfer ownership of {team} to {name}? You will become an admin.
danger.deleteHint: Permanently deletes this team, its memberships, and pending invitations.
danger.deleteDialogBody: Deleting {team} removes all team memberships and invitations. Cancel any active subscription first. This cannot be undone.

invite.title: Join {team}
invite.invitedBy: {inviter} invited you to collaborate in {team} on SupoClip.
invite.invitedGeneric: You have been invited to collaborate in {team} on SupoClip.
invite.signInHint: Sign in or create an account with {email} to accept this invitation.
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {signedInEmail}, but this invite was sent to {invitedEmail}. Sign out to switch accounts.
invite.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Please try again.
invite.notFoundBody: This invitation link is invalid or no longer exists.
invite.acceptedBody: This invitation to {team} has already been used.
invite.revokedBody: An admin revoked this invitation to {team}. Ask them to send a new invite.
invite.expiredBody: This invitation to {team} has expired. Ask a team admin to resend it.

toasts.subscriptionProcessing: Checkout complete. Your team plan will finish activating shortly.

errors.nameTooShort: Team name must be at least 2 characters.
errors.seatLimitReached: Seat limit reached. Add more seats before inviting another teammate.
errors.inviteRateLimited: Too many invitations in a short time. Try again later.
errors.seatPaymentFailed: The payment for the extra seats didn't go through. Update the payment method in Manage Billing and try again.
errors.teamLimitReached: You've reached the number of teams one account can own. Delete one you no longer use first.
